lines.say: a form of vitamin B3 the body turns into NAD+, which cells use to make energy
blood NAD+ reliably rose in trials, most of them small
generally no NAD+ rise in muscle, and no gain in muscle function or exercise
modest drops in some blood markers of inflammation, its most consistent effect
no gain in insulin sensitivity in several placebo-controlled trials
brain NAD rose in 30 with Parkinson's; symptom gains only in an after-the-fact subgroup
cholesterol rose with NR plus pterostilbene, triglycerides with NR (two trials)

ask: Should I avoid NR products combined with pterostilbene because of my cholesterol?
